hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was tending to the lamps when I heard a soft rustle. My heart beat wildly as I crept through the dimly lit hall. There, in the shadows, I glimpsed the new maid’s silhouette, her fingers fumbling with the tallow candle. I couldn’t help but notice how the wax dripped onto the cold linen, and how her breath misted in the chill air. It felt like a moment frozen in time, as if I were watching a masterpiece unfold.
caption:
Caught in the act! 💡
